description: RegExp.prototype.exec, mongoose Query.exec() and redux-saga fork are not shell sinks; a destructured child_process exec in the same file still is.

expected.notes: regex literal / RegExp object .exec on request data, mongoose .exec(), and a cookie-parsing loop are not command execution
no shell sink exists in these handlers
exec destructured from child_process inside the handler is still a shell sink (bare =exec gate)
